variants.headline: Home world answers colony's petition
variants.body: The home world has answered the colony's petition. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: A reply to the colonial petition
variants.body: A reply to the colony's petition has come from the home world. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Petition receives an answer
variants.body: The colony has received an answer to its petition from the home world. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
